title: “Apple/Google Support” found a charge
scenario: A pop-up says your app-store account bought $149 of game currency. A support chat opens automatically and asks you to install a profile so they can cancel the purchase.

answers.A: Close the pop-up and check purchase history in your actual app-store account; contact support from there if needed.
answers.B: Ask a parent or trusted adult to help review the account before installing anything.
answers.C: Install the profile but remove it after the refund is complete.

explanation: Fake purchase alerts create urgency and borrow a trusted brand. Configuration profiles can grant powerful device access.
proTip: Refunds do not require surrendering device control.
